Name: Renamer
Author: irocendar
Description:
[size=5][b]Renamer[/b][/size]

Partner named your kid Megatron? Didn't mean to call your farm Stardew Farm Farm? Called your kid Baby One and now they're a toddler? Worry not, Renamer adds a menu that allows you to change all of these names in a click.

Comes with a translation into every language the game comes with.

[size=5][b]Instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Download the mod[/*]
[*]Unzip into your [font=Courier New]Mods/[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Open the menu. By default, this is done via the [font=Courier New];[/font] (semicolon) key on your keyboard, the [font=Courier New]Share[/font] or [font=Courier New]Back[/font] keys on a controller, or through Iconic Framework or Better Game Menu (optional).[/*]
[*]You can reconfigure the opening keys in the config file or through Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Compatible With[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Better Game Menu:[/b] open using the pencil menu tab.[/*]
[*][b]Iconic Framework:[/b] open using the pencil icon.[/*]
[*][b]Android SMAPI[/b] and [b]Cinderbox[/b][/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer [/b](splitscreen [i]and[/i] normal)[/*]
[*][b]Translations: [/b]the name of the menu and the mod's name in GMCM are automatically translated into the language you're using for every language included in the game.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Special Thanks[/b][/size]

[size=5][b]Permissions[/b][/size]

Icon asset by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/suzukiPC]Pau[/url] and may not be used.

This mod has a two line i18n. If you want to contribute a translation for a non-vanilla language, please send me the i18n file and I will add it into the mod with credit, but don't post an entire translation mod.

While this mod is open-source, I prefer that it not be reposted or forked (here or on any other platform) while I'm still active in the modding community.
